method: Stationary native forest inspection, 22 seconds, first-person Balanced 640×360, June afternoon clear. One initial diagnostic pose at the existing forest station, no movement or clock change. Separate from the bridge route. Real post-limiter audio and VP8/Opus frame times, remux only. Per-frame data drained to Node at most every two seconds to bound instrumentation. SwiftShader, not physical GPU performance. Frame intervals include recording overhead.
